name: Umbral Eje
motion: The leaf turns 90° on an off-centre floor pivot set a quarter of its width in, holds, and closes (clip Door_Pivot, 5.8 s).
options: Glass: Claro low-iron, Satinado inner lite, Bronce outer lite
Divided lites: 3 × 6 grid, four horizontal lites, none
Handle: round pull (machined steel), lever on a narrow plate
Handle finish (5, chosen apart from the frame)

hotspots.title: Off-centre pivot
hotspots.text: Tap to open. The leaf turns on a floor pivot set 370 mm in from its edge, so 3 m of steel and glass moves under one hand.

hotspots.title: Handle
hotspots.text: A round pull machined from solid steel, on both faces. The alternative is a lever on a narrow plate.

hotspots.title: Five finishes
hotspots.text: Frame and leaf in Bronce Umbra, Latón Cepillado, Acero Grafito, Negro Carbón or Anodizado Natural. The handle takes its own finish.

hotspots.title: Glazing
hotspots.text: Two 10 mm low-iron lites around a 20 mm cavity. Claro, Satinado or Bronce.

hotspots.title: 49 mm sightline
hotspots.text: 12 mm frame, 8 mm gap, 12 mm leaf and a 17 mm bead: 49 mm of steel per side. The frame is 84 mm deep.

hotspots.title: Divided lites
hotspots.text: Bars on both faces with a spacer between the panes. A 3 × 6 grid, four horizontal lites or none.

gaps: Sizes, pivot offset, leaf depth and glass build-up are estimates carried over from the source build (no published figures).
Hotspot positions are set for 1520 × 3050; on the other sizes the finish and handle markers sit a few cm off the frame.
Source polished stainless and Cor-Ten finishes dropped (no close Umbral finish); Piedra, Roble Ahumado and Nogal not offered on steel.
Material records are named 'Umbral – <Finish> · Eje' because material names must be unique per account; shopper swatches show the plain finish name.
Stills: plaster wall and limestone floor beyond the model's own wall stub were added in the render scene only. No video made.
